entities.name: Lewis Hamilton
entities.description: Hamilton debuted at the 2007 Australian Grand Prix, becoming the first black driver to compete in Formula One. He holds over 90 records in Formula One, including the most race wins (106), pole positions (104), podium finishes (208), and championship points (5,232.5). Hamilton won his seventh title in 2020, tying the all-time record set by Michael Schumacher.

entities.description: Hamilton won the championship, becoming the then-youngest driver to win the title, aged 23 years and 301 days.
